title: 2026 Binance hack
extract: On 29 October 2026, 6.3 billion US dollars worth of digital currency was stolen from Binance, a cryptocurrency exchange, allegedly by the North Korea-linked hacking group TraderTraitor. The exchange hack is the largest-ever cryptocurrency heist, surpassing the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in 2025, with the most affected blockchains being Ethereum and Bitcoin. On the day of the heist, approximately $3 billion of the stolen stablecoins were frozen. North Korea has since denied being behind the theft.
